title: Writing Jock-A-Mo and its success in New York
summary: He wrote the song from Mardi Gras Indian ideas at 19, and its success led to a New York trip needing special club permission.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: What was the, what was, did you write Ico Ico? Yeah. Where'd you, where'd you get the idea for a song?
Mardi Gras, Indians. Did you know any Indian tribes?
No. Anybody in the tribes? No. You weren't any of the tribes?

Just by here and, and I did that when I was, I was 19 years old. Because I remember that because this record made a sort of hit in New York. And a guy from New York sent for me to come up there and play for him. And they had to get permission for me to go into nightclubs. And because they wasn't serving, letting anyone under 21 in the nightclubs. So I was 19. So they had to get the special permission for me to go up there. Yeah. To a bit.
